_doc: Machine-readable content calendar — the engine resolves an intent like 'this week' to a concrete slot. This is the machine form of 00-Project Overview/content-calendar.md (which stays the human narrative). Send day/time and lead times are still To Be Confirmed there; the MVP uses ISO week only. In the MVP, if no slot matches, the engine synthesizes a default Weekly slot for the current ISO week (it does NOT invent product/theme data — those still come from the live catalog).

slots.objective: Recurring product-led Weekly send: surface the current, in-stock featured range and drive traffic to live product pages.
slots.note: isoWeek:null = template slot applied to whichever week the run targets. Theme is derived from the live catalog at generation time (never invented).
